national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Team India for WorldSkills Competition 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with Team India representatives for the WorldSkills Competition, Shanghai 2026, in New Delhi.
Team India secured the 10th position at the 48th WorldSkills Competition held in Shanghai, winning 6 Silver Medals and 20 Medals for Excellence with a contingent of 70 competitors.
The Prime Minister emphasized that practical skills are as important as academic degrees and stressed the importance of establishing India as a global hub of skilled human resources.

national_news.title: Andhra Pradesh Mementos Featured in PM Mementos E-Auction
bullets: 18 mementos from Andhra Pradesh, featuring Kondapalli Woodcraft, Kalamkari art, and traditional crafts, are part of the ongoing PM Mementos e-auction.
The collection also includes contemporary items like the Stree Shakti Pratibha Award-2025 Commemorative Memento and Good Governance of India paintings.
Proceeds from the PM Mementos e-auction are directed towards the Namami Gange programme for the conservation and rejuvenation of River Ganga.

national_news.title: Digital Trust and ABHA IDs in India's Healthcare System
bullets: As of September 17, 2026, India recorded 97.61 crore ABHA IDs in operation with 119.95 crore health records linked to them.
Over 50 crore teleconsultations have been conducted in the country, including services through the government's e-Sanjeevani platform.
The article highlights the necessity of robust digital trust and continuous identity verification frameworks in healthcare, referencing past CAG audit findings on Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.

national_news.title: INS Kulish Arrives in Singapore for Operational Turnaround
bullets: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Kulish arrived at Tuas Terminal in Singapore for operational turnaround (OTR) as part of the Eastern Fleet's operational deployment.
The visit aligns with India's Act East Policy, MAHASAGAR vision, and aims to strengthen bilateral maritime engagement and regional cooperation.

INS Kulish and INS Sahyadri recently participated in the 23rd ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) Experts' Working Group on Maritime Security Joint Cooperative Activity at Subic Bay, Philippines.

national_news.title: Government Caps Trade Margins on Non-Scheduled Anti-Cancer Drugs at 30%
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers approved a 30% Maximum Retail Price (MRP) cap on trade margins for non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs.
The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) will issue the notification following the finalization of the drug list by a DGHS expert committee.
The decision is expected to reduce non-scheduled anti-cancer medicine prices by up to 70% and save patients approximately ₹2,500 crore annually.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates 10th India Mobile Congress in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 10th edition of the India Mobile Congress (IMC) at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, with the theme 'Scale Without Boundaries'.
Key statistics highlighted include 5G connectivity reaching every district across India through more than 5,50,000 base stations.
Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia highlighted that data costs dropped from ₹268 per GB in 2014 to around ₹8 per GB today.

national_news.title: Union Finance Minister Chairs 57th GST Council Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, focusing on dispute resolution and Input Tax Credit (ITC) flow.
A five-pronged plan was proposed covering process reforms, structural reforms, ease of living and doing business, exports of services, and e-commerce.
Key initiatives include automatic invoice matching, reducing paperwork for ITC claims, and easing return filing frequency for small businesses.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Bullet Train Project: Patna Selected Among 5 Proposed Stations
bullets: Bihar is included in the Varanasi-Patna-Siliguri high-speed rail corridor announced in Union Budget 2026-27.
Five districts identified for bullet train stations are Patna, Buxar, Begusarai, Khagaria, and Katihar.
The project will leverage Japanese Shinkansen high-speed rail technology.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹1.88 Lakh Crore Energy Investment
bullets: Bihar proposed ₹1,88,383 crore in energy-sector investments covering generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy.
The state targets 24 GW of renewable energy and 6.1 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2029-30.
Proposals include a 2,800 MW nuclear power project in Banka and 8,400 MW of pumped storage across four districts.

bihar_news.title: Bihar MSME Policy 2026 Launched to Make Families Self-Reliant
bullets: Bihar launched the MSME Policy 2026 with a target to make one crore families self-reliant through entrepreneurship.
The government plans to develop 45,000 entrepreneurs with an outlay of ₹3,500 crore.
Bihar aims to attract ₹5 lakh crore in industrial investments and provide 20,000 MW of power to industries over five years.

bihar_news.title: Patna High Court Directs Reconsideration of Pay Protection and Pension for Long-Serving Employee
bullets: The Patna High Court directed Bihar's Water Resources Department to reconsider the service, pay protection, and pensionary claims of a daily-wage employee who worked continuously since 1980.
The petitioner was regularized as a Lower Division Clerk in 2012, but his absorption was treated as a fresh appointment, reducing his basic pay from Rs. 9,840 to Rs. 7,730.
The Court instructed the competent authority to examine the claims under Rule 78 of the Bihar Service Code and the Bihar Pension Rules, 1950, within three months.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Directs Officials to Expedite 'Seva Sankalp, Kayakalp' Campaign
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister directed departments to expedite the 'Seva Sankalp and Kayakalp Abhiyan' to ensure time-bound completion of public infrastructure projects without compromising quality.
The campaign focuses on improving basic facilities in schools, healthcare institutions (primary and sub-divisional health centers), Anganwadi centers, and public utilities.
Key directives included ensuring clean drinking water, electricity, and boundary walls in schools, along with the repair of streetlights, tubewells, and bus stand beautification.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 1 Crore Entrepreneurs by 2030 Under Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced a target to create employment opportunities for one crore people by 2030 through enhanced entrepreneurship and MSME growth.

Financial assistance instalments were disbursed to around 7,000 beneficiaries under the Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana, which provides up to Rs 10 lakh (50% grant/subsidy and 50% loan) to eligible categories.
Under new public procurement rules, Bihar-based enterprises ranking L2, L3, or L4 in government tenders up to Rs 50 crore will be considered if they match the L1 rate.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Court Convicts Former Rohtas SP for Contempt and Critiques IAS/IPS Training Systems
bullets: A Bihar District and Additional Sessions Court convicted former Rohtas Superintendent of Police Raushan Kumar for contempt over wilful failure to comply with judicial directives regarding criminal antecedent reports.

The court imposed a symbolic fine of Re 1, ordered entry into his service record, and criticized deep shortcomings in the training curricula of IAS and IPS officers regarding institutional accountability.
The court recommended that the Union Ministry of Personnel and Training overhaul civil servant training to ensure better deference to judicial mandates and summons.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Offer 5 Regional Languages for Classes 1-5 under NEP 2020
bullets: Bihar plans to introduce Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi, and Angika as additional language options for Classes 1 to 5.
The initiative aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 emphasis on mother tongue and regional language education.
Other educational developments include a proposed 5-acre Gurukulam Vidyapeeth in Simri, Buxar, and tracking dilapidated school buildings via the e-Shikshakosh portal.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Sets Aside Reinstatement of Bihar Teacher Lacking NCTE Qualification
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed the State of Bihar's appeal, dismissing the reinstatement of a teacher appointed in 2007 under the Bihar Panchayat Elementary Teacher (Employment and Service Conditions) Rules, 2006.
The respondent lacked a valid teaching qualification recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) at the time of appointment.
The bench emphasized that eligibility criteria under statutory rules must be strictly fulfilled and assessed at the time of appointment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Forest Department and RCD Sign MoU for NH-333 Widening Project through Gangata Forest
bullets: Bihar's Road Construction Department (RCD) and Forest Department signed an MoU to widen a 10.5-km section of NH-333 passing through the Gangata forest in Munger district into a two-lane road.
The project requires 2.1 hectares of forest land from the Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary at a revised cost of Rs. 510 million.
The forest department later withdrew from execution responsibility following concerns raised regarding potential conflict between its regulatory and project-delivery roles.
